time_basis: seconds from start of the uploaded video, NOT game clock
policy: Each visible replay is a separate occurrence. Review entire video before marking reviewed=true. [] with reviewed=false means unknown, not absent.

queries.definition: Start at the visible shooting motion; end at visible outcome or shot cut. Do not label dribbling or passing. Count a replay as a separate visible occurrence.
Same shot boundary rule, but the shooter must visibly wear a dark jersey. No team identity inferred from filename.
Visible free-throw shooting motion through outcome/cut. Presence and count require full review.
Visible celebratory gesture by bench players, not any bench shot. Start/end with the gesture or shot cut.
A player head/shoulders is a prominent subject; not wide court footage. Split at cuts to unrelated scenes.
Require visible dunk evidence, not a layup or ordinary jump shot. Presence/count not assumed.
Candidate absent event. Mark as negative only after reviewing the entire video.
